This '''[[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commando]]''' was a member of [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane's]] posse. He was disguised as a [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commando]] during the [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|Senate hostage crisis]], and later successfully left the crime scene with the other members of the team and [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]].
